text.p: SKOPJE, Dec 12 (Retuer) - These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified them nor does it vouch for their accuracy.
- The Macedonian Constitutional Court rejected an opposition demand for early elections, ruling that according to the Constitution parliamentary elections can only be held once every four years.

- The vice-governor of the Macedonian National Bank, Dusanka Hriistova said the value of the Macedonian Denar against the Deutsch Mark would rise from 27.80 denars to the mark to 27.40. The temprary rise in value was due to the local elections.

- Negotiations between Greece and Macedonia over Macedonia's name are to continue next week. The Maceonian press speculates that names under discussion include "New Macedonia", or "Republic of Macedonia (Skopje)".
